# Test that a missing page renders a real 404 page and reveals no paths

cd testdir

md2html -http :8096 -nav &
wait-port :8096

# The status is a 404 and the body is a rendered page, not plain text
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8096/nope
stdout '404'

curl -s http://localhost:8096/nope
stdout '<h1.*>Not found</h1>'
stdout '<html'
stdout 'No page matches'

# The requested URL is echoed back; the filesystem paths md2html searched
# are not
curl -s http://localhost:8096/nope
stdout '/nope'
! stdout 'testdir'
! stdout 'no such file'

# Navigation survives, so a wrong link is recoverable
curl -s http://localhost:8096/nope
stdout 'Guide'

# The ?file= form reports the same way
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://localhost:8096/?file=missing.md'
stdout '404'

# Under a prefix the page names the URL the client asked for, not the
# one left after the prefix was stripped
md2html -http :8097 -base /docs &
wait-port :8097

curl -s http://localhost:8097/docs/nope
stdout 'No page matches /docs/nope'

-- testdir/index.md --
# Welcome

-- testdir/guide.md --
# Guide
